subject: Plan unbundling: opt-in microfeatures and rollover credits for pilot customers
messages:
From: James Barton <james.barton@medquest.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot packaging question — microfeatures & rollover credits

Hi Soojin,

Quick question as we prepare for our pilot: MedQuest wants to start with the core inference plan but only enable 3 add-on features (response-prioritization, KV-prefetch, and fine-tuned-reranking) for a limited set of flows. Two asks: 1) Is there an easy way to "opt-in" microfeatures for a pilot without moving the whole account to a new tier? 2) If we buy reserved capacity for the quarter and don't consume the full allocation, can any unused capacity/credits roll over into the next quarter (or be applied to the initial Dedicated commit)?

If it helps, our pilot is 3 months, target ~120k tokens/day on day-1, potential scale after month two. We need to know how flexible seat/tier swaps are mid-contract.

Thanks — happy to take a 30-min sync.

James
Director of AI Ops
MedQuest

Attachment: pilot-requirements-summary.docx (docx)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: James Barton <james.barton@medquest.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot packaging question — microfeatures & rollover credits

Hi James — thanks for the detail. Short answers up front: yes, and yes (with limits).

We support opt-in microfeatures via a "modular add-on" flag on hosted plans — you can enable features for specific routes or API keys without changing the global tier. For pilots we recommend a scoped feature bundle (three features enabled only for pilot keys) and a temporary cap on throughput.

On credits/rollover: we can offer a limited rollover in the form of a credit voucher applied toward the next quarter or toward an initial Dedicated commit, but it needs to be bounded (we usually cap at 50% of unused committed units and limit to one-quarter rollover for pilots).

Two follow-ups: 1) I attached a short one-pager with microbundle options and costs. 2) Can you share whether procurement needs this as a PO/commit or will sign a pilot MSA? That affects our pricing path for rollover.

If you're open, I'll loop in our pricing lead and customer growth to propose 2–3 concrete options.

Best,
Soojin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: microbundle-options-onepager.pdf (pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot packaging question — microfeatures & rollover credits

Team — forwarding MedQuest ask. Key constraints: 3-month pilot, scoped to a subset of routes, potential to convert to Dedicated after month 2. Requirements: ability to opt-in microfeatures for only pilot keys, capped rollover credit (one-quarter, up to 50% unused committed units), and a one-time mid-term seat/tier swap w/out penalty.

Proposal sketch (we need pricing and sign-off):
- Option A (Low friction pilot): Hosted plan + microbundle (3 features) enabled per-key. No commit; usage billed metered. Pilot discount: 25% off per-token for 3 months. No rollover.
- Option B (Commit-lite): 3-month reserved commit (monthly prepay) sized at expected usage. 30% pilot discount, rollover up to 50% of unused committed tokens as credit toward next quarter or first month of Dedicated. One free "tier swap" allowed during pilot.
- Option C (Accelerate to Dedicated): Small Dedicated reserve (1 GPU pool) for pilot month 2 onward, 40% effective discount on per-token when converting; rollover credit applies if commit exceeds usage; migration assistance included.

Questions I need from you: Ben — margin/discount guidelines for pilot promos? Priya — how would the rollover credit flow through billing (invoice credit vs account credit)? Karthik — any ops constraints on allowing per-key enabled features and a one-time tier swap (routing/permission changes)?

Thanks — would like to respond to James with concrete numbers by Friday.

-Soojin

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot packaging question — microfeatures & rollover credits

Soojin — good framing. High level responses:
- Discount: for a 3-month pilot we can go up to 30% on metered or commit-lite, 40% only with a firm Dedicated conversion commit (sales must own conversion signal).
- Rollover credit: accounting prefers to issue an invoice credit (applied to next invoice) vs an open credit balance; we can support a one-time invoice credit equal to up to 50% of unused committed units. Need finance approval on legal language for refundable vs non-refundable commits.
- Tier swap: ops impact minimal if we treat it as a policy change on the routing layer + adjust quotas; one free swap allowed but it must be scheduled (we'll require a 72-hour notice window to avoid KV cache inconsistencies).

I'll approve Option B at 30% with the invoice-credit rollover and single mid-pilot tier swap as the recommended path. Priya/Karthik, can you confirm implementation notes?

- Ben

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: James Barton <james.barton@medquest.ai>, Angela Mooney <angela@medquest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot packaging question — microfeatures & rollover credits

Hi James/Angela — thanks for the patience. We've pulled the team together and have a recommended path for the pilot. Attached is a short proposal and a pricing workbook; below is the TL;DR and next steps.

TL;DR (recommended): Option B — Commit-lite pilot
- 3-month reserved commit sized to your expected usage (we can set it to 110% of day-1 forecast to provide buffer).
- Pilot discount: 30% off per-token pricing for the term.
- Rollover: if you underutilize the commit, we will issue an invoice credit equal to up to 50% of the unused committed tokens that can be applied to either the next quarter's hosted usage or toward the first month of a Dedicated conversion. Credit is one-time and expires at the end of the following quarter.
- Tier swap: one free mid-term tier/seat swap allowed with 72-hour scheduled window; ops will coordinate cache warm-up/route adjustments.

Options attached: MedQuest_Microbundle_Proposal_v2.pdf (includes per-feature unit prices and example math) and microbundle-pricing-onepager.xlsx.

Next steps:
1) If procurement needs a PO or MSA for the pilot, share procurement contact — we can route a pilot MSA template.
2) If you want the commit sized differently, reply with expected daily token curve and we’ll update the workbook.
3) Proposed quick sync: Thu 10/29 10:00am PT — I can send a calendar invite if that works.

Happy to adjust.

Best,
Soojin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MedQuest_Microbundle_Proposal_v2.pdf (pdf); microbundle-pricing-onepager.xlsx (xlsx)
